description:
The Changing Table - 6 Drawer has six drawers for onesies, sleepers, blankets, diapers, and wipes.

It measures 50¼ inches wide, 21¼ inches deep, and 33½ inches high.
title: Changing Table - 6 Drawer
metaDescription: The Changing Table - 6 Drawer from Fisher's has six drawers and measures 50¼ inches wide, 21¼ inches deep, and 33½ inches high.
usesCredit: Per Fisher's: the changing table has a removable top, so it can be used as a dresser later.
